extends.note: This file is a LOCAL EXTENSION layered on top of the bound N0 generic (non-SaaS) common policy n0-design-constraints-common 0.1.0, the common policy the N0 capture engine emits. It adds the consumer-service-marketplace (childcare) rules below; it does not replace the common policy. The binding itself lives in registry.manifest.json designPolicy.

title: Consumer service marketplace (childcare) web-product generation policy

notBoundTo.n0-saas-design-constraints-common: Explicitly NOT applied. That policy assumes a B2B SaaS product (pricing tiers, dashboards, feature matrices, integrations). This repo is a consumer marketplace marketing site; none of those constructs exist here and a generator must not introduce them. The 2026-10-29 architecture decision binds the generic non-SaaS common policy n0-design-constraints-common 0.1.0 instead (see approval).

generationRules: Pages are drawn only from the 11 templates and 30 section contracts; no pricing-table, feature-matrix, integrations, dashboard or changelog sections.

Every PageSpec declares mode: clone (faithful reconstruction of withotter.com) or generation (a different brand). Generation pages carry no source brand, people, press marks, screenshots, copy, claims, URLs or embeds, and substitute the chrome-owned identity through generationContext (GENERATION_MODE_* rules).
Page-level tokens come only from tokens/llm/token-catalog.json under tokens/llm/token-policy.json; no raw colours, lengths or font names (TOKEN_* rules).
Trust and safety content (verification, background checks, press marks) is first-class and must use the pinned asset roles; never fabricate.
Copy addresses two audiences (parents, sitters); audience-landing is the only template that switches audience.
Real people, real third-party logos and operative legal text are must-not-fabricate (see assets/asset-roles.json); a generated legal page uses documentRef operator-supplied.
The auth entry (auth-light) stays a separate design system and is never merged into the marketing namespace (TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION, AUTH_SYSTEM_ISOLATION).

approval.decidedBy: repository owner (user), recorded by Claude in the review session
approval.decision: Otter binds to the N0 generic (non-SaaS) common policy n0-design-constraints-common, version 0.1.0 (Common IR 0.5, enforcement hard-and-soft). The consumer-service-marketplace-web 1.0.0 rules in this file are a LOCAL EXTENSION layered on top of that common policy, not the bound common policy. Otter is not bound to n0-saas-design-constraints-common.
approval.scope: This decision covers the policy binding only. Legal-content sign-off and asset-licensing review are separate approvals, still open in registry.manifest.json approvalFlags (legalContentSignOff, assetLicensingReviewed), and they continue to block production use.
